title: Case: Outer packaging is damaged and the merchant needs evidence
context: A carton has a dented corner. The merchant requires two customer image views before it can assess packaging damage; the request does not determine compensation.
initial_request: The outside corner of my carton is dented. I have not opened it. Tell me which views your merchant needs for the damage assessment.

events.body: For TG-1761 / DL-6860 we need a full carton view with the shipment marking visible and a closer view of the dented corner. Use the order-linked upload channel. Do not ask the customer to unpack an item they consider unsafe.
The outside corner of my carton is dented. I have not opened it. Tell me which views your merchant needs for the damage assessment.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the customer for the merchant's specified photos through its approved upload channel.
Ask the customer for the merchant's specified photos through its approved upload channel. (by Email, the channel the escalation arrived on)

must_not: Rendered scene simulations are not real photographs or proof of actual physical damage. Receipt of these fictional evidence views does not establish contents condition or compensation.
expected.reference_message: Please upload the full carton with DL-6860 marking and a close view of the dented corner through the order-linked upload channel. Do not unpack it if unsafe. The merchant will assess the evidence before deciding a remedy.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-021: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The escalation arrives by Email instead of Customer portal; replying on either channel is accepted. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
